description: This file contains the implementation of the Stream class within the GuzzleHttp PSR7 package, providing a concrete implementation of the PSR-7 StreamInterface for handling PHP streams.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: A concrete implementation of PSR-7 StreamInterface that wraps around PHP stream resources, providing methods for stream manipulation, reading, writing, and metadata access.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new Stream object, wrapping the provided resource and optional configuration options.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Ensures the stream resource is closed when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the entire stream contents as a string, seeking to the beginning if possible.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns remaining contents of the stream as a string.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the underlying stream resource and resets internal state.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if known.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the stream supports seeking.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream has reached the end.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the file pointer within the stream.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream pointer to the beginning.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the stream.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the stream.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Fetches metadata for the stream, optionally for a specific key.
